messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU pool 'prod-gpu-a' saturation detected — avg GPU utilization 94%, queue growth +1200 reqs in 5m, autoscaler attempted scale but hit max_replicas. Paging oncall.
Alex Chen: I'm on it. seeing a big spike in queued prefill and long context allocations. which rollout is live?
Maria Lopez: v30.7 rolled ~13:05 UTC (hotpatch to tokenizer + default ctx_len bump). I'm seeing KV cache warmup OOM-ish patterns on logs.
Samir Patel: Graphs: prefill rate up x3, median tokens/request +2.6x, KV cache miss rate skyrocketed. Autoscaler logs show 'quota_exceeded: replica_limit' around 13:12.
Elena Kuznetsova: confirm autoscaler refused new nodes due to project quota (soft limit 40). cloud team notified but likely takes ~20m to provision additional quota.
Priya Nair: Customers seeing 503/429 on /v1/generate and higher latencies. Support already flagged top 5 affected orgs. I'll draft an update once we have mitigation.
Alex Chen: Quick mitigation options: 1) Roll back v30.7 to v30.6 (fast) 2) Route some traffic to fallback model v29 3) Emergency increase replica limit (if cloud team can) 4) Apply short-term rate limit on prefill endpoints + reduce default context on v30.7.
Samir Patel: I'm leaning rollback + temporary route fallback. Rolling back reduces risk of introducing more regressions during scaling window.
Maria Lopez: If we rollback we need to disable the new default ctx_len param in config; rollout service has a 'canary-weight' flag — can do 100% -> 0%.
Alex Chen: I'll run the rollback. @deploy-bot can you start rollback for model v30.7 -> v30.6 now? paste command and I will approve.
deploy-bot: Command queued: `redwood deploy rollback --model v30.7 --to v30.6 --force --reason "autoscale saturation"`
Alex Chen: Approving and running.
Alex Chen: Executed rollback. Watching queues.
Samir Patel: Queues dropping, health checks still flapping on a few nodes (prefill-heavy). Latency 95th dropped from 6s -> 2.2s in 4 minutes.
Elena Kuznetsova: Cloud replied: quota increase request acknowledged, ETA ~18m for new nodes. We should not rely solely on that.
Priya Nair: Support note: initial customer impact window 13:10-13:25 UTC. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (prefill-heavy), customers: AcmeCorp, BetaAI, Currents.
Maria Lopez: We should also patch autoscaler to better honor pool-burst policies and not lock on replica_limit error — filed temporary ticket: AS-2981.
Samir Patel: One more mitigation we applied: rate-limited prefill route by 40% using gateway throttle (command below). It bought us headroom.
Samir Patel: ```
# gateway throttle
redwood gateway update-route --name prefill --rate-limit 40% --reason "emergency throttle to stabilize" 
```
Alex Chen: Nice. Also disabled KV cache warmup prefetch on v30.6 to avoid aggressive memory touch during warmups.
Maria Lopez: Noted a handful of workers still reporting kv-cache growth; we're initiating a rolling recycle for hot nodes to free fragmented GPU memory.
Elena Kuznetsova: Rolling recycle command sent to infra: `infractl pool recycle --pool prod-gpu-a --batch 4` - expected 6m to finish.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed and traffic routing reverted to v30.6.
status-bot: INCIDENT: mitigation in place. Queues decreasing, autoscaler no longer at quota. Monitoring for 30m.
Priya Nair: Draft status update for customers: "We experienced elevated latencies and 429/503 errors for generation endpoints due to an unexpected load increase associated with a model rollout. Traffic has been rolled back to a previous model and throttles applied; services are stabilizing." I'll share first update in #customer-status.
Alex Chen: Post-incident actions agreed: 1) Hotfix to rollout validation to check ephemeral ctx_len ramp and simulated KV warmup 2) Autoscaler needs better handling of replica_limit (AS-2981) 3) Add pre-rollout load test for 2x token amplification 4) Run RC with canary weight 5) Customer communication and RCA.
Samir Patel: I'm capturing logs for postmortem: saved kv-metrics, autoscaler traces, and deploy events (tag: incident-1765012345).
Maria Lopez: Assigning leads: Samir -> Postmortem lead, Elena -> Infra follow-up, Alex -> Deployment controls and rollout guard rails.
Priya Nair: I'll stitch support timeline and affected customer list. ETA 2h for initial root-cause note.
Alex Chen: Thank you everyone. We'll keep this thread for final handoff. If anyone needs to escalate to execs or legal, ping me directly.
status-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) at 13:32 UTC. Please follow up with postmortem and update tickets.
Maria Lopez: Closing handoff. Oncall shift ends in 20m; leaving notes for next oncall. Final action items added to board.
